name: stores
lead: Shared durable storage: the experience's one store, leases and raw queries; calls yield.

functions.name: open
functions.description: Returns the experience's one store. It takes no id; passing one is an error.

functions.name: request
functions.signature: stores.request(query: {[string]: any }, bytes: string ?) → ({[string]: any }, string ?)
functions.description: Sends one raw query to the store and yields until it answers; returns the answer table and any blob bytes.

functions.name: lease
functions.signature: stores.lease(key: string, holder: string, ttl_ms: number) → number
functions.description: Takes a lease on `key` for `holder`, lasting `ttl_ms` milliseconds (up to one hour); returns a fencing token.

functions.name: renew
functions.description: Extends the lease on `key` that `token` holds.

functions.name: release
functions.description: Gives up the lease on `key` that `token` holds.

functions.name: blob_list
functions.signature: stores.blob_list(owner: string) → {{store: string, key: string, version: number, size: number }}
functions.description: Lists a player's blobs across all blob stores in this scope, each with its store, key, version and size.
